method: NAIP 2022-07-19 detail ortho (0.625 m/px). Green evidence = ExG>0.05 & not-water, dilated 1.5 m. Grass placement removed iff no green evidence AND ground brightness >= 0.60 (bare sinter/mineral/road). Dark-ground no-evidence records (riparian shadow / wet bank) reviewed and KEPT, listed under kept_dark.
